title: Nivea sales drag down Beiersdorf in Q3 2026 amid Middle East war concerns
summary: Beiersdorf’s hero skin care brand Nivea was impacted by temporary sell-in headwinds, which resulted in group net sales declining 1.3% to €2.4bn
